title: Bind historical task-brief residue on immutable incumbent promotion
head_binding_policy: The final PR head SHA is bound by REVIEW_HEAD_SHA at independent reviewer approval time via scripts/git/task_review_merge_gate.py. This evidence manifest does not claim a commit can contain its own SHA.

incident_reproduction_analysis.cause: The live incumbent running at accepted dev ancestor 5877b64425c8d6aede147d6cbbc6fbb9e228c259 carried historical tracked task brief .orchestrator/task-briefs/sup_runtime_v10_promotion_git_dir_enotdir_20260808.md. incident_reproduction_analysis.repair: Updated CandidateRuntimeIdentity and verify_working_tree_cleanliness to accept allow_legacy_task_brief_drift=True when capturing an incumbent in OSPromotionBackend.prepare. Added registered provenance binding for SUP-RUNTIME-V10-PROMOTION-GIT-DIR-ENOTDIR-20260808. Hard-link rejection added to OSLaunchFilesystem.capture_regular_file (st_nlink == 1 requirement). Strict cleanliness gates remain enforced for candidate_root.

safety_and_coherence_invariants.incumbent_root_mutation: Zero incumbent root mutations (no reset, checkout, stash, clean, or file modification).
safety_and_coherence_invariants.candidate_cleanliness: candidate_root cleanliness requirement remains strictly 100% clean with allow_legacy_task_brief_drift=False.
safety_and_coherence_invariants.provenance_binding: Incumbent legacy task brief drift is bound to exact PID, starttime, cwd, commit, tree, remote, config, byte provenance, and st_nlink == 1, failing closed on unverified, hard-linked, symlinked, or changed residue.
safety_and_coherence_invariants.launch_identity: Launch source contracts, config CAS, process signalling, -B / PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, 3 fresh loops, and rollback cleanup remain preserved.

no_live_rollout_boundary: This task is source-only. No live config edits, direct process signals, live runtime promotions, candidate deletions, canonical state edits, or fleet scheduling changes were performed.
